Subject: Re: Premium SLA needs for checkout (BrightCart)

Mike — thanks for the clear asks and for sharing the volume estimates. High level: we can support both the 99.95% and 99.99% bands, with distinct escalation ladders and credit formulas. I’m attaching a matrix (redwood_sla_matrix_v3.pdf) that lays out three practical packaging options — Core, Shield, and Sentinel — plus the credit math. Quick summary below:

- Core (entry): 99.9% uptime, P1 ack 60 min, P1 on-call escalation to L2 within 8 hours. Credits = 5% monthly credit for each .1% below target, cap 25%.
- Shield (recommended for checkout): 99.95% uptime, P1 ack 30 min, P1 L2 escalation within 4 hours, optional 24/7 on-call with on-call engineer for an hourly retainer. Credits = 7.5% credit slab per 0.05% below target, cap 30%.
- Sentinel (strict): 99.99% uptime, P1 ack 15 min, immediate L1 -> L2 escalation within 60 minutes, guaranteed cross-region failover playbook and quarterly DR runbooks. Credits = 10% slab per 0.01% below target, cap 40%.

Pricing & discounts: to offer any material discount on Shield/Sentinel we need a committed spend / minimum retainer. Examples: 12-mo commit at $150k/month unlocks 20% tier discount on retainer and a 30-day onboarding SLA; 6-mo at $80k/month unlocks 10% discount. I’d recommend Shield + a modest retainer for on-call coverage for checkout.

Next steps
- If you can confirm preferred uptime band and expected committed monthly spend, I’ll loop in Finance for a firm quote and Vanessa for commercial approval.
- We can add a short EU failover addendum (latency SLO may vary depending on runbook).

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
